heading: PROFESSIONAL PROFILE
items: Award-winning Senior Lecturer and health professions education researcher with more than 10 years of tertiary and clinical education experience in Hong Kong and South Africa. I combine programme coordination and assessment quality assurance with practical implementation of generative AI, VR/XR and simulation. My PhD used design-based research to develop guidance for implementing VR in health professions education. Through educator development, collaborative funded projects and evidence-informed evaluation, I translate educational needs into learning designs and implementation processes.

heading: CURRENT ACADEMIC APPOINTMENT & LEADERSHIP
items: Senior Lecturer in Physiotherapy | Saint Francis University, Hong Kong | Apr 2024 – Present

Coordinate and deliver undergraduate learning across foundational science, movement science, health technology and clinical/professional areas, connecting learning outcomes, teaching activities and assessment.
Serve as Year 1 Head Teacher, supporting cohort transition, mentoring, induction, teaching-plan coordination and programme-level student support.

Lead and contribute to internal moderation and assessment quality assurance: develop rubrics and cases, coordinate moderators, support continuous and summative assessment planning, and contribute to marksheet processes and practical/OSPE assessment.
Coordinate with colleagues on programme-wide teaching plans and curriculum alignment across four BSc Physiotherapy year levels, following through on implementation and access issues.
Develop and implement VR, AI, simulation and digital-assessment activities with attention to constructive alignment, learner safety, accessibility, responsible use and iterative evaluation.
Supervise Honours Research Projects and contribute to clinical-education development, curriculum review, outreach, final-year research support and programme administration.
Work with clinical educators and external partners to strengthen the academic-to-clinical transition and students' professional readiness.

heading: EDUCATIONAL DEVELOPMENT & DIGITAL LEARNING PORTFOLIO
items: Responsible AI & Digital Learning

Designed Socratic AI-supported clinical-reasoning activities that require students to gather data, generate and evaluate hypotheses, justify decisions and reflect on reasoning rather than receive direct answers.

Developed assessment approaches combining AI-use disclosure, prompt/process documentation, oral defence and critical appraisal, requiring students to explain and take responsibility for AI-assisted work.
Implemented pseudonymised chatbot workflows in simulation and used learner interaction, performance and usage data to support evaluation and iterative improvement.
Immersive Learning, VR/XR & Simulation

Developed and implemented immersive and mobile VR learning across anatomy, health technology and procedural/clinical learning, using curriculum alignment, safety cues, structured practice and evaluation.
Developed an acupuncture VR sequence incorporating theory, training, practice, assessment, safety prompts and usage analytics to support continuous improvement.

Contribute to simulation-based education, including interprofessional nursing-physiotherapy simulation, airway-clearance/suctioning scenarios, standardised-patient work, pre-briefing/debriefing and practice-readiness activities.
PhD developed evidence-informed guiding principles for VR implementation in health professions education using design-based research.
Curriculum, Assessment & Quality Enhancement
Apply constructive alignment, curriculum review, learning-outcome mapping and assessment redesign in undergraduate health-science education in Hong Kong.
Design and moderation of case-based assessments, rubrics, practical examinations and OSPE-style activities, with emphasis on reliability, transparency, feedback/feedforward and academic integrity.
Use student feedback, implementation evidence and learner-usage data to identify issues and inform quality enhancement; distinguish engagement measures from demonstrated learning outcomes.
